provenance.asset_description: Iconic Inventor Droven: a bald half-orc with a clockwork prosthetic arm and scar marring his left eye. He wields a large bronze hammer that looks like equal parts weapon and tool and is accompanied by a small mechanical goblin with a toolbox built into its back
